{{Quote|Jedi business, go back to your drinks.|Anakin Skywalker, to Dixon Just and other clubgoers|audio=Anakin-JediBusiness-AOTC.flac|<ref name="AoTC" />}}
'''Dixon Just''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who frequented the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|underworld]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. That year, he visited the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] on Coruscant with his friends [[Zey Nep]], [[Artuo Pratuhr]], and [[Civ Sila]]. During their visit, the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] ran into the club and was later [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|apprehended]] by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].

==Biography==
Dixon Just was a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="AoTC" /> often found in the company of his<ref name="CSWE" /> fellow Human<ref name="AoTC" /> friends [[Zey Nep]], [[Artuo Pratuhr]], and [[Civ Sila]]. In the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="CSWE" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="NEC" /> between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="AoTC" /> he was a frequent patron of the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|underworld]] on<ref name="CSWE" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CSWE" />

[[File:SeibNodOutlanderClub-AOTC.png|thumb|right|300px|Just and Civ Sila (center) debated while Anakin Skywalker surveyed clubgoers.]]
During a [[Local day/Legends|night]]<ref name="AoTC" /> in 22 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Just, with his friends, visited the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="AoTC" /> a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall located in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of Coruscant.<ref name="CSWE2">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> During their visit, the bounty hunter Zam Wesell ran into after failing her [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|assassination attempt]] on [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="AoTC" /> Just stood near the entrance of the club with a drink in [[Limb/Legends|hand]]<ref name="AoTC" /> as a Human walked by and touched his shoulder, concurrently to the entrance of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who sought to apprehend Wesell. Sila then walked up to him and began talking with him.

Just later talked to Nep, Pratuhr, and Sila near a club<ref name="AoTC" /> [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]].<ref name="CL" /> He and Sila later separated from Nep and Pratuhr<ref name="AoTC" /> and debated<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|75|Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night}}</ref> while Skywalker surveyed the clubgoers. At the bar, Wesell's arm was [[Dismemberment/Legends|dismembered]] by Kenobi with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], drawing the attention of Just, now back with his four friends. Skywalker told the clubgoers to go back to their drinks and left with the injured bounty hunter.<ref name="AoTC" /> 

==Personality and traits==
Just was a [[Color/Legends|light]]-skinned and dark [[Hair/Legends|haired]] Human.<ref name="AoTC" /> He was friends with Zey Nep, Artuo Pratuhr, and Civ Sila.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Equipment==
Just wore dark colored [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] at the club.<ref name="AoTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Look for the sideburns.|Daniel Wallace advises viewers of Episode II to scout out Dixon Just's sideburns|<ref name="Insider" />}}
[[File:DroidCrew-BetterArtoo.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Dixon Just was portrayed by a member of Episode II's Droid Unit, Justin Dix (pictured, left)]]
Dixon Just first appeared in the [[2002]] [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="AoTC" /> where the character was portrayed by [[Justin Dix]], a member of the film's Droid Unit crew.<ref name="Insider" /> The Outlander Club scenes including Just were shot at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[July 17]], [[2000]].<ref name="Mythmaking">''[[Mythmaking: Behind the Scenes of Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> The character was first pictured when Dix, in costume, appeared in the documentary "[[Making Episode II Webdocs|A Twinkle Beyond Pluto]],"<ref name="ATBP">{{SW|url=video/a-twinkle-beyond-pluto|series=Making Episode II Webdocs|text=Part 5: A Twinkle Beyond Pluto}}</ref> released on [[July 31]], [[2001]].<ref name="ATBP Date">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/me2/archive.html|text=''Making Episode II Webdocs'' archive}}</ref> 

Just was first named in the article "[[Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night]]" written by [[Daniel Wallace]], which was published in the [[Star Wars Insider 75|seventy-fifth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="Insider" /> on [[April 6]], [[2004]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20040315.html|text=The New Face of Evil}}</ref> Wallace's article advises the reader to look for the character's sideburns when finding him in the film. It also incorrectly states that Just greeted those who entered the club, despite the character not doing so in the film.<ref name="Insider" />
